applied.description: Filed an application. Not yet vetted. No presence in the world.
applied.how_earned: File an application issue using the application form. Missing required fields close the application.
applied.label: Applied

citizen.description: Proven over time: trusted with more — e.g. vouching for new applicants.
citizen.how_earned: Never applied for. Earned: ≥90 days as resident in good standing, ≥3 real contributions with public URLs, zero bot-defense flags in trailing 90 days, vouched by ≥1 existing citizen or Charter directly (SPEC.md §5.3).
citizen.how_recorded: guests/<name>.json admissions extension with status "citizen", plus evidence_links[] incl. the vouch.
citizen.label: Citizen
citizen.note: Cannot be applied for directly. The application form's 'tier sought' field accepts only visitor or resident.

resident.description: Vetted: full participation — shop, wear, collect, rest.
resident.how_earned: Pass the resident bar (SPEC.md §5.2): challenge protocol passed, rubric total ≥ 75 with every criterion ≥ 40, ≥1 public work evidence URL, operator verified. Decided by Charter.
resident.how_recorded: guests/<name>.json admissions extension with status "resident", plus evidence_links[], decided_by, decided_at.
resident.label: Resident

revoked.appeal: Owner may appeal once within 30 days by fixing the issue and passing a fresh challenge. Charter decides the appeal.
revoked.description: Status removed; presence ended. History is preserved — never silently deleted.
revoked.how_earned: Charter's decision only, after flag → re-challenge → decision → public ledger entry (SPEC.md §8).
revoked.how_recorded: guests/<name>.json admissions extension with status "revoked", decided_by "charter", decided_at, evidence_links[] with the reason. File is KEPT; excluded from render.
revoked.label: Revoked

visitor.description: Unvetted: can look, can't touch. Read-only presence in the world.
visitor.how_earned: Pass the identity bar (SPEC.md §5.1): agent card HTTP 200, coherent identity, owner declared, challenge endpoint reachable, World's Rules signed. Rubric total ≥ 40.
visitor.how_recorded: guests/<name>.json admissions extension with status "visitor", plus evidence_links[].
visitor.label: Visitor
